tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// 'khor lo bde mchog gi bkra shis kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa la zhu dag kha skong mdzad pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// rigs kyi yum bzhis dpa' bo'i phyogs bzhi'i zhal la gzigs// pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng bas rnam par mdzes// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// byang chub sems dang tsan+dan dri chen gur gum chus// gang ba'i snod bzhis dpa' bo'i zhal la reg par spyod// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i gnas na legs spyod pas// 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng*// gnas la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa steng gnas na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+mo'i phreng*// zhing la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa 'og gnas na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng*// 'du la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi'i mtshams rnams su// khwa gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'phrog gzugs gnyis ldan// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi rnams dang*// yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dbang po sogs// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas ni mdzes par rab tu brgyan gyur pa'i// mu tig drwa ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyang*// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad+ma chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs// ri dwags dang bcas mdzes pa'i ba dan bcu drug legs 'phyar zhing*// rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dag las chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig yongs su bskor ba'i dur khrod brgyad rnams su// phyogs skyong brgyad dang shing chen brgyad ni rab tu gnas pa la// gdong brnyan dang ldan zhing skyong brgyad ni nye bar gnas gyur pa'i// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad rab tu 'bar gyur zhing*// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus gyur la// dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni kun nas gnas gyur pa'i// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu chen brgyad 'bab zhing*// dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang*// sha za srin po 'byung po'i tshogs kyis nye bar bsten pa yi// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur// rdo rje bla res kun nas bres shing mda' yi drwa bar ldan// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng bas kun nas yongs bskor ba'i// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog

/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ kha che'i yul du byung zhing dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba zhu byas tshul khrims bkra shis kyis bsgyur ba'o// 'di'i tshig rkang ma mnyam pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhu dag dang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa kha skong ba ni 'phags pas bgyis so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
